C1538.title: The Life-or-Death Security Challenge for Crypto Exchanges: A Deep Dive into Technology, Management, and Coordination
C1538.summary: An analysis published on February 28, 2025, reveals that in the Bybit hack, attackers bypassed the security of cold wallets and multi-signature mechanisms by forging executive instructions and tampering with the front-end interface. The article explores the limitations of multi-signature schemes when confronted with social engineering attacks.

references.title: The Life-or-Death Security Crisis of Cryptocurrency Exchanges: In-Depth Reflections on Technology, Management, and Collaboration - Tencent News
